lead: A balance assertion across a primitive that *reports* a refusal reads the report as a leak.
body: `abi::report_refusal` runs `Ctx::memory_breach`, which `format!`s the message the `FATAL` carries, so `nvs_array_append`'s refusal moves `budget::live_bytes` by a couple of hundred bytes while `nvs_array_set`'s moves it by nothing. Assert "allocated nothing" on the primitives that answer a degenerate value, and assert the status plus the unchanged operand on the ones that answer a status.
